summary: poll_deadline_hosttest.c, which requires the poll, ppoll and select timeouts to end at the first tick at or after their end, measured from where in the tick in progress they began, and a deadline to be reached at its tick and not before, across the wrap and after a lost tick, with 20 faults in a private copy of rach2/sys/io/poll.c; one of three proofs of the host rows on wait deadlines, the timer's tick and the kinds of change a wake counts, split by test; the build copies rach2/sys under the work directory

argv: set -e; rm -rf ${WORK}/b; mkdir -p ${WORK}/b/rach2; cp -R rach2/sys ${WORK}/b/rach2/; cp ${SRC}/rach2/sys/io/poll.c ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/io/poll.c; deps=; for dep in $(grep -oE 'host-deps:[^*]*' tests/host/poll_deadline_hosttest.c | sed 's/host-deps://'); do case $dep in rach2/sys/*) deps="$deps ${WORK}/b/$dep" ;; *) deps="$deps $dep" ;; esac; done; ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -ffreestanding -Wno-int-to-pointer-cast -Wno-pointer-to-int-cast -I ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys -I ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/arch/x86 -I ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/arch/i686 -I ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/lib -I ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/proc tests/host/poll_deadline_hosttest.c $deps -o ${WORK}/poll_deadline_hosttest

faults.name: poll-early
faults.summary: a poll, ppoll or select timeout rounded down to the tick

lines: a poll of 1 ms from tick 1000 ends at 1001
a ppoll of 1 ns from tick 1000 ends at 1001
a select of 1 us from tick 1000 ends at 1001

faults.name: poll-phase
faults.summary: a timeout measured from the tick, not from where in the tick it began

lines: and one of 7 ms at the tick after

faults.name: poll-clamp
faults.summary: the longest ppoll timeout not clamped to 0x7FFFFFFF ticks

lines: the longest ppoll timeout ends 0x7FFFFFFF ticks ahead across the wrap
and its deadline is not reached at the tick it began

faults.name: ppoll-nsec
faults.summary: a ppoll's nanoseconds rounded down to microseconds

lines: a ppoll of 1 ns from tick 1000 ends at 1001

faults.name: ppoll-sec
faults.summary: a ppoll second counted as ten ticks

lines: a ppoll of 1 s and 11 ms from tick 1000 ends at 1102

faults.name: select-usec
faults.summary: a select's microseconds rounded down to milliseconds

lines: a select of 1 us from tick 1000 ends at 1001

faults.name: poll-reached
faults.summary: a deadline taken as reached a tick early

lines: a deadline one tick ahead is not reached

faults.name: poll-late
faults.summary: a deadline taken as reached a tick late

lines: a deadline at the tick or behind it is

faults.name: poll-wrap
faults.summary: a deadline compared without the wrap

lines: and its deadline is not reached at the tick it began

faults.name: tick-nearest
faults.summary: a timeout rounded to the nearest tick, not up

lines: a poll of 21 ms rounds up to three ticks
a ppoll of 1 s and 11 ms from tick 1000 ends at 1102

faults.name: ppoll-sec-clamp

lines: the longest ppoll timeout ends 0x7FFFFFFF ticks ahead across the wrap

faults.name: tick-round-one
faults.summary: a timeout rounded up from one unit less than a tick

lines: a ppoll of 1 ns from tick 1000 ends at 1001

faults.name: ppoll-nsec-one
faults.summary: a ppoll's nanoseconds rounded up from one less than a microsecond

lines: a ppoll of 1 ns from tick 1000 ends at 1001

faults.name: select-zero
faults.summary: a zero select timeout rounded up to a millisecond

lines: a zero select timeout ends at once

faults.name: select-sec
faults.summary: a select second counted as 100 milliseconds
